description_en: Moves hosts to a different project in a batch
description_zh: 批量修改主机所属项目
name: ModifyHostsProject

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to which the hosts currently belong
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the target project to which you want to move the hosts.
You can call the ListProjectsForProjectAuthorizationPrincipal operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要移动到的目标所属项目 ID。
您可以调用ListProjectsForProjectAuthorizationPrincipal接口获取该参数
parameters.name: target_project_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts that you want to move. This parameter is a JSON-formatted string. You can specify up to 100 host IDs. Separate multiple host IDs with commas (,).
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要移动的主机ID。该参数为JSON格式的字符串，最多可输入100个主机ID。多个主机ID之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_ids

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Results.description_en: The call results of the operation

items.description_en: The call results of the operation

Code.description_en: The error code. A value of 200 indicates that the operation was successful. Other values indicate that the operation failed
Code.description_zh: 错误码。错误码为200时，表示操作成功；其他错误码表示操作失败

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of hosts that were successfully moved
